source_register.title: Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Programme
supports: SARB describes an insights capability and fraud framework as PEM programme work

source_register.title: PEM Working Groups
supports: A Fraud and Intelligence Information Sharing Forum exists for PEM private-sector stakeholders
does_not_support: A production person-level blacklist or live API

source_register.title: Positioning the SARB's Payments Ecosystem Modernisation Programme
supports: The PEM position paper proposes a central fraud and intelligence management capability
does_not_support: Operational availability or private-sector safe harbour

source_register.title: PEM Industry Dialogue April 2026 Day One
supports: April dialogue describes PEM design and work in progress
does_not_support: A deployed national fraud framework or live API

source_register.title: Information Sharing to Combat Illicit Finance: Global Overview of Public and Private Sector Partnerships and Data Protection Arrangements
supports: FATF identifies at least 84 public-private partnerships globally
Robust legal basis, governance and data protection safeguards are essential
Strategic typology sharing and operational case sharing differ
does_not_support: South African private-sector permission or universal fraud scoring

source_register.title: Financial Sector Regulation Act 9 of 2017
supports: Section 251 addresses information handling by SARB and financial-sector regulators within statutory functions and safeguards
does_not_support: A blanket private-sector permission or safe harbour

source_register.title: Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013
supports: POPIA establishes conditions for lawful processing of personal information including purpose and retention safeguards
does_not_support: A determination that a particular exchange is lawful or that pseudonymisation is anonymisation
